subject: science
concept: Asking a testable question about something observed in the natural world
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Asking Questions) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student observes something puzzling (e.g. why does ice melt) and turns their curiosity into a spoken question
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts questions into 'can test this' and 'can't easily test this' piles
exercise.abstract: Student writes a simple testable question based on an observation

misconception_flags: asks a question that isn't actually testable through observation or a simple experiment

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
